user.title: Add Open Data
user.description: Choose how you want Open Data to find the public data source.

menu_options.local: Find useful data for my area
menu_options.website: Add from a website or dashboard
menu_options.known: Add a known portal, dataset, API, or ID

local.title: Find useful data for my area
local.description: Sources are ranked using your Home Assistant location, formal coverage, practical relevance, and extraction-test history. 'Tested' means the source has actually been exercised by the Open Data extraction corpus; discovered/untested sources may still require new resolver or provider support.

website.title: Find the data behind a website
website.description: Paste a public webpage, dashboard, chart, portal, or data page. Open Data will inspect bounded public page evidence for upstream APIs, files, feeds, spreadsheets, and embedded data services without executing arbitrary page JavaScript.

resolved_source.title: Choose an upstream data source
resolved_source.description: Open Data found these likely machine-readable sources behind the page. Choose the source that should be inspected next. A resolved source may still require provider/feed support before it can be imported.

known.title: Add a known data source
known.description: Paste a portal, catalog, dataset page, resource/API URL, or dataset ID. Dataset links import only that dataset; portal roots start bounded catalog discovery.

data.source_location: Portal, dataset, API URL, or ID
data.portal_url: Portal URL for a bare ID (optional)

portal.title: Discover public datasets
portal.description: Enter an institution's public data portal URL. Open Data will prepare and cache the site structure. Large catalogs and file resources can take several minutes; you can leave this screen and return later.

dataset.title: Add a dataset directly
dataset.description: Paste a CKAN or Socrata dataset page, resource/API URL, or dataset ID. A portal URL is required when entering an ID by itself.

data.portal_url: Portal URL for a bare ID (optional)

discover.title: Choose discovered datasets
discover.description: Found {count} ranked datasets on {portal} using {provider}. Dataset preparation will infer fields, observation time, freshness, stable records, timestamp semantics, and measurement behavior before creating Home Assistant entities.

prepare.title: Prepare site catalog
prepare.description: Preparing the site catalog in the background. You may close this dialog and return later; no entities or regular downloads begin until you select a dataset.

progress.prepare_catalog: Inspecting the portal, cataloguing datasets, and saving the catalog for later selection

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the supplied source.
error.invalid_reference: The source reference could not be recognized or resolved. Check the URL or provide the portal URL for a bare ID.
error.unsafe_source: The supplied source was blocked by Open Data's network safety checks.
error.invalid_dataset: The portal or selected dataset is invalid.
error.no_datasets: No suitable queryable datasets were discovered on this portal.
error.no_machine_source: No public machine-readable source was found in the bounded page evidence. The page may use an unsupported embed, authenticated API, or JavaScript-only data loading.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This open data resource is already configured.
abort.no_local_sources: No source profiles in the current audited corpus were relevant to the configured Home Assistant location.

init.title: Advanced field review
init.description: Dataset structure: {kind}. Automatic assignments are preselected. Change these only when the importer misunderstood which columns describe location, time, measurements, or context.

structure.title: Advanced unit and hierarchy review
structure.description: Define stable units and observations only when automatic structure inference needs correction. Hierarchy sets run from broadest to most specific.

temporal.title: Timestamp and timezone override
temporal.description: Use automatic inference unless the source's observation time was misunderstood. A user-selected timestamp field is persisted and reused on every refresh. Enter an IANA timezone such as America/Detroit or Europe/Paris for naive local timestamps.

records.title: Review imported records and measurements
records.description: Observation time: {temporal_status} using {timestamp_strategy} ({timestamp_confidence} confidence). Timezone: {timezone} ({timezone_source}). {stale_count} measurements are currently classified stale and are excluded by default unless you select them. Record mode: {record_mode}. This review observed {record_count} records/locations and estimates {entity_estimate} measurement entities from the current bounded selection. If the provider returns the full cardinality cap, Open Data does not show that truncated list as if it were complete.

error.invalid_field_roles: One or more field assignments were invalid. Review the selected fields and try again.
error.invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone name, for example America/Detroit or Europe/Paris.
error.invalid_timestamp_field: Choose a timestamp field from this dataset.
